input.description: Extract outcomes from today's work transcripts

input.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path("/Users/mac/.dc-platform/memory/mirrors/agent-transcripts/new-mac/8be7c202-360e-4dd2-8ce1-38226b138e5a/8be7c202-360e-4dd2-8ce1-38226b138e5a.jsonl")

def extract(o):
    role=o.get("role")
    msg=o.get("message") or {}
    content=msg.get("content") if isinstance(msg, dict) else None
    texts=[]
    if isinstance(content, list):
        for x in content:
            if isinstance(x, dict) and x.get("type")=="text" and x.get("text"):
                texts.append(x["text"])
    return role, "\n".join(texts)

n=0
with p.open() as f:
    for line in f:
        o=json.loads(line)
        role, text=extract(o)
        if role!="assistant" or not text: continue
        # skip very short
        if len(text)<80: continue
        n+=1
        print(f"\n===== A{n} len={len(text)} =====")
        print(text[:900])
print("TOTAL long", n)
PY
